code: defmodule ChatApp.MessageStore do use GenServer def start_link(_opts) do GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__) end def init(state) do {:ok, state} end def store_message(room_id, message) do GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:store, room_id, message}) end def get_messages(room_id) do GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get, room_id}) end def handle_call({:store, room_id, message}, _from, state) do messages = Map.get(state, room_id, []) updated = state |> Map.put(room_id, messages ++ [message]) {:reply, :ok, updated} end def handle_call({:get, room_id}, _from, state) do {:reply, Map.get(state, room_id, []), state} end end defmodule ChatApp.Sanitizer do @doc "Sanitizes user input for safe HTML rendering" @entity_map %{ "<" => "<", ">" => ">", "&" => "&", "\"" => """, "'" => "'" } def sanitize(text) when is_binary(text) do text |> normalize_unicode() |> escape_html_entities() end def sanitize(other), do: to_string(other) |> sanitize() defp normalize_unicode(text) do # Normalize to NFC form to prevent bypass via decomposed characters :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(text) end defp escape_html_entities(text) do Regex.replace(~r/[<>&"']/, text, fn char -> Map.get(@entity_map, char, char) end) end end defmodule ChatApp.MessagePipeline do @moduledoc "Processes messages through transformation pipeline" alias ChatApp.Sanitizer defstruct [:raw_content, :sanitized_content, :metadata, :render_mode] def new(content, metadata \\ %{}) do %__MODULE__{ raw_content: content, sanitized_content: nil, metadata: metadata, render_mode: determine_render_mode(metadata) } end def process(%__MODULE__{} = msg) do msg |> apply_sanitization() |> apply_formatting() |> finalize() end defp determine_render_mode(%{content_type: "text/markdown"}), do: :markdown defp determine_render_mode(_), do: :plain defp apply_sanitization(%{render_mode: :markdown} = msg) do # Markdown mode: sanitize but preserve markdown syntax sanitized = Sanitizer.sanitize(msg.raw_content) %{msg | sanitized_content: sanitized} end defp apply_sanitization(msg) do %{msg | sanitized_content: Sanitizer.sanitize(msg.raw_content)} end defp apply_formatting(%{render_mode: :markdown} = msg) do # Convert basic markdown after sanitization formatted = msg.sanitized_content |> String.replace(~r/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/, "\\1") |> String.replace(~r/\*(.+?)\*/, "\\1") %{msg | sanitized_content: formatted} end defp apply_formatting(msg), do: msg defp finalize(%{sanitized_content: content}), do: content end defmodule ChatApp.WebSocket do @behaviour :cowboy_websocket alias ChatApp.{MessageStore, MessagePipeline} def init(req, state) do room_id = :cowboy_req.binding(:room_id, req) {:cowboy_websocket, req, Map.put(state, :room_id, room_id)} end def websocket_init(state) do room_id = state.room_id # Send message history to newly connected client Task.async(fn -> messages = MessageStore.get_messages(room_id) {:history, messages} end) {:ok, state} end def websocket_handle({:text, raw_json}, state) do case Jason.decode(raw_json) do {:ok, %{"type" => "message", "content" => content} = payload} -> metadata = build_metadata(payload) processed = MessagePipeline.new(content, metadata) |> MessagePipeline.process() MessageStore.store_message(state.room_id, processed) broadcast_frame = Jason.encode!(%{ "type" => "message", "content" => processed, "room" => state.room_id }) {:reply, {:text, broadcast_frame}, state} {:ok, %{"type" => "system", "action" => action}} -> handle_system_action(action, state) _ -> {:ok, state} end end def websocket_info({ref, {:history, messages}}, state) when is_reference(ref) do Process.demonitor(ref, [:flush]) frames = Enum.map(messages, fn msg -> {:text, Jason.encode!(%{"type" => "history", "content" => msg})} end) {:reply, frames, state} end def websocket_info({:DOWN, _ref, :process, _pid, _reason}, state) do {:ok, state} end def websocket_info(_info, state), do: {:ok, state} defp build_metadata(%{"content_type" => ct}) when ct in ["text/plain", "text/markdown"] do %{content_type: ct} end defp build_metadata(_), do: %{} defp handle_system_action("ping", state) do {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{"type" => "pong"})}, state} end defp handle_system_action(_, state), do: {:ok, state} end
